literal: Do not desire wealth becoming yours by having coveted; at the time of yielding, difficult for greatness will be the result.
translation: Do not desire the wealth that comes from coveting the property of others. When it finally yields its result, that fruit will be entirely devoid of greatness.
modern: பிறர் பொருளை விரும்பிப் பெறும் செல்வத்தை ஒருவன் விரும்பக் கூடாது. அச்செல்வம் பயன் தரும் காலத்தில், அப்பயன் நன்மையைத் தருவது அரிதாகிவிடும்.
explanation: The couplet warns against desiring wealth acquired through coveting what belongs to others. Although such wealth might seem like a gain initially, the word 'விளைவயின்' (at the time of yielding) points to its ultimate consequences. When the time comes to reap the fruits of that ill-gotten wealth, the result ('பயன்') will be entirely devoid of greatness or true benefit ('மாண்டற்கு அரிதாம்'). Thus, the initial desire for wrongful accumulation leads only to a worthless and harmful end.
